stories.title: Our guide to every NFL Week 9 game: Matchup previews, predictions, picks and nuggets
stories.summary: Bills vs. Vikings? Drake Maye vs. Jordan Love? The NFL in Madrid? There are 14 more games in Week 9, and we have picks, predictions and more for all of them.

stories.title: Sources: Rams' Garrett on track for return vs. Commanders
stories.summary: Rams star pass rusher Myles Garrett is on track to be activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game at the Commanders, sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Patriots' Henderson: Tests reassuring after 'unexplained neurological symptoms'
stories.summary: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson said tests have come back positive after he suffered "unexplained neurological symptoms" that remain "unknown and unexplainable."

stories.title: Rivers: Giannis was playing games when trying to leave Bucks
stories.summary: Former Bucks coach Doc Rivers said Giannis Antetokounmpo "didn't want to be the bad guy" when he was trying to seek a trade out of Milwaukee last season.

stories.title: Blue Jays: Santander's anti-Muslim posts don't represent team
stories.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays say a series of anti-Muslim videos posted by Anthony Santander on the right-fielder's social media account do not represent the team's values and beliefs.
